mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 20-day forward periods following FEDFUNDS declines exceeding 0.25pp over 3 months, average returns are negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% indicates a tightening labor market, strengthening corporate earnings prospects and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.5%, 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% signal robust economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO and HOUST both rise >0.5% MoM, 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.25pp signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25%, 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior 6 months signals labor market strengthening, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60-day forward periods following UNRATE declines exceeding 0.3pp over 6 months, average returns are negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100), a further decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99 signals deepening economic weakness, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 99, 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding $470 billion signals strong consumer spending, driving immediate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to near-term earnings momentum.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 470000, 5-day forward returns are negative in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annual decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 2.0% signals disinflation, reducing real interest rate pressures and supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60-day forward periods following annual CPIAUCSL declines below 2.0%, average returns are negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.
